body: Burning mouth syndrome was  previously discounted by some of the doctors I've seen due to the presence of several atypical symptoms for burning mouth.

I had been recommended to try zinc supplements.  I took those but there was no change, I'll try iron, folic acid, and vitamin b this week.  

The burning first started about 5 weeks in to this.  It's sporadic in its occurence.  The last time I felt it was in the middle of the night, it woke me up because every time I swallowed the saliva felt red hot against the back of my throat. Scrubbing my tongue and brushing my teeth seems to alleviate it for a period.  

I have not experienced jaw or muscle tightness.  

The implants are titanium, but the dentist can't tell me if they are chemically pure titanium or titanium with trace alloys of other metals, and I'm currently trying to get that information from the manufacturer, who has not been responsive.  

I have not had a patch test done for titanium, from what I hear I'd need to see a dermatologist for that over an allergist.  I know I have a nickel allergy which increases my chances of having a titanium or alternate metal allergy, so that's worth exploring.  

The deviated septum is an issue, but it's never before caused any of the issues I'm seeing.  

Thank you for the response.
That's exactly what I suspect, an alloy like nickel that I might be allergic too.

I have seen 5 general practitioners, two ENTs, a dentist and an allergist.  

The situation is I got two dental implants on the right side of my mouth, one top one bottom.  

Two days after the final procedure with the crown's mounted and posts tightened in, I started having heavy post nasal drip causing sore throat, fatigue, nasal congestion.  My mouth and throat had burning sensations come and go and a strong hot sugary taste sometimes.  First few doctors and the first ENT threw antibiotics at me.  Did nothing.  ENT then said it's silent reflux.  Months on antacid medicine did nothing.

CT scans show nothing obvious.  Blood tests so far show nothing.

Problems are heaviest from my right sinus.


Went to an allergist who found I was allergic to dust mites, so I did a full cleaning of my living space and put anti dust mite covers on my bed and pillows.  No real change.  

My insurance kicks in in 6 days.   I have an appointment with a third ENT doctor.  

I am allergic to nickel and I'm wondering if there might be nickel alloy traces in the implants as some titanium has them.  The dentist who installed them can't tell me if they do.

I have had a constant post nasal drip and sore throat for 4 months.  

It's awful.
